segments.name: Banking
segments.description: Provides banking services, including lending, deposits, cash management and wealth management, to individuals and companies in western Massachusetts and northern Connecticut.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single reportable segment under ASC 280, as the Chief Operating Decision Maker ("CODM") reviews financial performance and allocates resources based on the consolidated results of the Company as a whole.

revenueModel.text: The bank earns interest on its loans and securities and pays interest on its deposits and borrowings, with net interest and dividend income as its primary profit measure.
revenueModel.evidence: Net interest and dividend income is the difference between the interest income earned on interest-earning assets and the interest paid on interest-bearing liabilities.
